takeaways.text: Route on **86%** / blocks on **14%** of dropbacks (95% CI 80–91%, n=152) — about the RB average (82%).
On routes, averages **6.4 yd** downfield by the throw vs 4.9 for RBs (deeper) (n=131, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Backfield (80%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (6.3 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
